messages:
anita_cs: Noticing a pattern from three onboarding sessions this week: customers confused by 'per-route billing' wording in the console and can't find invoice previews. Two are flagged as renewal-risk (trial accounts). We need a repeatable capture so CS can funnel these straight to product.

rachel_enablement: +1. On enablement calls this week it's taking ~4min to explain where cost lines live. We should capture whether it's a docs issue vs console UI wording. Would love a tiny Slack modal for CSMs to file these.

mike_product: Happy to take these. Minimal fields: org, contact, onboarding step (call/email), problem (one-liner), observed behaviour, expected behaviour, severity suggestion, sample account id, screenshots/links. If we get multiple reports with the same phrasing we escalate to a quick UX review.

sam_engineering: For prioritization, also include affected routes (e.g., embeddings/rlhf) and whether the customer uses Dedicated or Hosted. That often changes the fix surface. I can add a checkbox to the webhook payload to include logs if available.

anita_cs: Proposed modal copy (short):

```
Problem: 
Customer (org + contact): 
Onboard channel: call / email / support ticket 
Observed: 
Expected: 
Frequency: one-time / occasional / every session 
Product area: console / billing page / API docs 
Account id (optional): 
Attach: screenshot/link 
Suggested priority: low / med / high
```

rachel_enablement: That fits. I'll ask CSMs to use it during calls tomorrow. If we can auto-tag with "onboard-ux" in tracker that's ideal.

capture_bot: New entry created: CAP-2026-842 "Invoice preview missing in console" — submitted by rachel_enablement. URL: https://tracker.internal/CAP-2026-842

mike_product: I'll create the tracker label and schedule a 30min triage slot tomorrow. If we have 4+ captures in the next 10 days, we'll queue a UX spike.

sam_engineering: Building the Slack shortcut + webhook tonight. @anita_cs please DM me a sample account id so I can test repro metadata.

anita_cs: Done, sent in DM. Thanks all — expecting first live captures after tomorrow's enablement sessions.
